method: two unchanged modules; browser.js has Android conversation/toggle/submission/phase hooks; protocol.js adds schema dialects, normalized history and strict Agent completion; dom-text.js isolates the current turn
domTextPatch: Exclude fingerprint-checked historical answers, old thinking and old completion controls from each new turn.
Restore markers after a matching DOM re-render; reject changed/missing history instead of mixing responses.
timeoutPatch: Recheck wall time when a timer fires so a rounded/early tick cannot expire a request ahead of its deadline.
Classify total deadlines versus observation budgets from the selected budget, not an incidental clock read.
protocolPatch: Select Ajv draft-07, draft-2019-09 or draft-2020-12 from the tool schema declaration.
Keep schema keywords and validate real tool arguments; do not strip the declared dialect.
Strict tool mode requires explicit complete/needs_input for content-only replies and rejects final statuses containing tool calls.
persistencePatch: Restore bounded fingerprinted conversation associations after checking their paths and structure.
Keep bounded task and request records with exact protocol result frames and hashed idempotency keys.
Never auto-run restored interrupted work; tool execution remains owned by the calling client.
browserPatch: DOM reader supports mobile state attributes, component classes, tabs and native checkbox controls.
Thinking/search mode switches confirm the observed final state.
Android submission hook clicks one verified send control; default desktop Enter contract is retained in the shared class.
A state read ending at the submission deadline reports unconfirmed submission consistently, without resubmission.
Unknown, contradictory and ambiguous state remains an explicit error.
